_ad_note: Plex free ads are CSAI: a SECOND <video> element playing a plain https .mp4 (content <video> keeps its blob: src, PAUSES in place, stays mounted). Observed live 2026-06-13: 3 creatives/break (30s+30s+15s), ad element UNMOUNTS at break end, content resumes at same ct — so `video[src*='.mp4']` is an exact presence marker (resolve() count>0 semantics safe). WITHOUT the marker the ad's src swap false-trips boundary_src and KILLS the record mid-ad (happened live: E03 cut at 369s). End detection is suppressed while ad_active — marker firing fully protects. EPISODE-END INTERSTITIAL: Plex swaps the player to a 'PLAYING NEXT' countdown page at content end (no audible stream → unmute-reassert spam; got baked into a file tail 2026-06-13) → '(?i)playing next' is an ad_marker ON PURPOSE: pause hides the interstitial, next ep's content unmatches it, resume → boundary_src cuts with a clean tail. CAUTION: do NOT use 'up next' — that string lives permanently in the LIVE-TV player metadata (PlayerControlsMetadata 'Up Next: …') = would fake-ad every live record.
